item.title: Coherent starts 300mm SiC sampling for AI chips
item.summary: Coherent has started sampling 300mm high thermal conductivity silicon carbide (SiC) substrates to semiconductor customers developing chips for artificial intelligence and high-performance computing. The move takes the company’s large-diameter SiC technology from internal development into customer evaluation as thermal management becomes a bigger challenge for increasingly power-hungry processors.
